title: Sensors and Feedback
description: Turn encoder readings into speed and distance, ignore stick drift with an if statement, then drive exactly 2 meters with bang-bang control.

checkpoints.title: Deadband and if statements
checkpoints.description: Constants.java has a DEADBAND constant, Robot.java uses it in an if statement on each stick, and autonomousPeriodic() has an if / else.

checkpoints.title: Log your numbers
checkpoints.description: robotPeriodic() logs linear_speed, angular_speed and distance_meters_ with MwLog.log, under the keys Robot/LinearSpeed, Robot/AngularSpeed and Robot/Distance.

checkpoints.title: Linear speed
checkpoints.description: Drive both sides forward at full speed. Robot/LinearSpeed should read about 5.9 m/s. If it reads about 50, GEAR_RATIO isn't set yet.

checkpoints.title: Angular speed
checkpoints.description: Spin in place at full speed (hold A, the left stick pushed left). Robot/AngularSpeed should be positive.

checkpoints.title: Drive 2 meters
checkpoints.description: Run Auto and let the robot stop. Robot/Distance should read about 2 meters (it coasts a little past, to about 2.7).
